old_mechanism: Correct local straddling holes mapped to an adjacent rather than opposite pair.
new_feature_correspondence: Whole bent two-face source-opening contours map to full coplanar four-edge windows of E; red and blue each identify one source opening and one E window.
new_geometric_misconception: Flatten a two-face bent opening into a face-interior rectangle, substituting apparent2D window shape for fold incidence. This loses the crease-straddling property, rather than the old adjacent/opposite placement property.
substantive_change: E differs topologically: only2affectedfaces versus target4. No earlier same-question design tested faceinterior binding. Whole window contour is used specifically as a2D shape receiver, not option salience.
human_semantics: All actual notch/hinge boundaries and hidden dash styles retained; no geometric equality, closed sourcecut or newfill. A human can track both target halves and reject E.
